title.narrative: Greening of Scrap Metal Value Chain through the Promotion of BAT/BEP to Reduce U-POPs Releases from Recycling Facilities

description.narrative: ..The proposal is formulated based on the priorities of Thailand reflected in its National Implementation Plan. The project aims to promote and introduce BAT/BEP measures in scrap metal recycling facilities in order to reduce releases of unintentionally-produced POPs
